name: Kazuma Shuuichi
source:
He is a young doctor on the rise, popular for his reputation, looks, and skills as a doctor.

He finds it odd that Nakada is so enthusiastic with his research, however, he does not share his same views, and he is not very interested in his research.

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/5386]official site[/url]]
